bug_semantics: Heap use-after-free (CWE-416) in GLX CommonMakeCurrent() in xorg-server/xwayland. oldTag is a pointer into cl->contextTags[]. After an old context is lost, CommonMakeNewCurrent() calls GlxAllocContextTag(), which may realloc(cl->contextTags) and move the array. The later GlxFreeContextTag(oldTag) then writes through the dangling pointer. A local client with a GLX connection can trigger this via glXMakeCurrent / glXMakeContextCurrent. Fixed by freeing oldTag before allocating the new tag.
flaw_origin: First written in 4781f2a5a8c2c2b000374e2d87982a6701d5a6b3 ('GLX: Free the tag of the old context later', author Doğukan Korkmaztürk, 2022-11-22). That commit delayed GlxFreeContextTag(oldTag) until after CommonMakeNewCurrent() so a failed make-current would not drop an still-active old tag. Immediate parent 3852b0d10a061348ea8214fbcbef3c5c08cac0b6 still nulls oldTag after CommonLoseCurrent and has no post-MakeNewCurrent GlxFreeContextTag(oldTag). The delayed-free placement is the UAF; the original glxvnd import freed earlier. Fix 2779affbdb4354e894f490e56f962527d6125043 names this commit in Fixes:.
